why: The wooden soldier with a clockwork key already has the courage and courtesy the Lamp wants, and it salutes when a task finishes, so I keep it.
style: Hand-made warmth: wood or brass, a visible clockwork key, and a courteous posture that reads as meaning well.
making: Worry: nineteen separate drawings may drift cold or chrome-like; the shared style sheet must hold every pet to the same warm, courteous hand.
